backend/main.mo: Actor defining access control, user approvals, profiles, and community posts using mixins and permission checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new state with plan and payment-request upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to impacted frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining global CSS variables and themes for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including Google Analytics and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router routes and maps them to page components within the AppLayout root.
frontend/src/components/admin/PaymentReq: Displays and filters payment requests for admins with status updates and loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Shows an access denied message with navigation buttons for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for users to enter and submit basic profile details with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/billing/ManualUp: Dialog for submitting manual UPI payment requests with transaction ID, optional screenshot upload, and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/common/BackToTop: Floating button that appears after scrolling and scrolls the page smoothly to the top.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Renders a community post with author details, content, tags, and relative timestamp.
frontend/src/components/community/Create: Dialog for creating community posts with type selection, caption, optional title, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/Des: Provides a design editing panel with tabs for templates, style, texture, and emojis, allowing users to customize and apply changes to a design preview.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/edi: Defines preset templates, style options, texture patterns, and default emojis used by the design editor.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/typ: Declares TypeScript interfaces for design previews, customization options, and editor preset types.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with layout structure, syncing user plan data and rendering navbar, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with product, company, and legal links plus social and attribution elements.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Displays the main navigation bar with links, authentication actions, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Profi: Provides a dropdown profile menu with account navigation and logout functionality based on user profile data.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Exports static copy for home, pricing, and creator pages, including text for UI sections and feature descriptions.
frontend/src/content/faqs.ts: Defines FAQ interface and exports a list of preset FAQ entries about WishMint AI features and usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommunityPosts.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch all posts, following posts, and create new posts using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity provider and hook for managing authentication, identity loading, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Hook for updating document title and meta tags, including Open Graph tags, based on provided options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, approvals, roles, payments, and posts using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining theme variables, dark mode, typography, utilities, and background effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard that checks admin access, lists approval requests, and allows approving or rejecting users.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Billing and subscription management page with UPI payment flow, plan selection, and payment status handling.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Static blog listing page displaying predefined posts with categories, dates, and read times.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Community feed showing all or following posts, with create-post dialog and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page offering email support, live chat, and additional contact addresses.
frontend/src/pages/CreateStudioPage.tsx: AI design creation interface with form-based inputs, preview generation, and design editing/customization.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorProfilePage.ts: Displays a creator’s profile with stats, bio, and a tabbed portfolio/reviews section using the username from the route.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorsPage.tsx: Shows a directory of creators with avatars, stats, and buttons to view individual profiles or follow them.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the user dashboard with authentication checks, profile info, usage stats, and navigation to creation and billing pages.
frontend/src/pages/FaqPage.tsx: Displays a FAQ list using an accordion, pulling question–answer items from static content.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage with hero content, a demo input preview, and feature sections promoting the AI design platform.
frontend/src/pages/LegalPrivacyPage.tsx: Shows the privacy policy with structured sections explaining data collection, usage, security, and user rights.
frontend/src/pages/LegalRefundPage.tsx: Renders the refund policy page with sections on guarantees, eligibility, refund requests, cancellations, and template refund rules.
frontend/src/pages/LegalTermsPage.tsx: Displays the Terms of Service including permitted use, restrictions, IP rights, payments, liability limits, and policy changes.
frontend/src/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx: Shows the template marketplace with search, filters, premium lock messaging, and purchase or upgrade handling.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Provides a 404 error page with navigation options to home or the marketplace.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Offers pricing tiers with monthly/yearly toggle and routes users to billing after selecting a plan.
frontend/src/pages/PublishPage.tsx: Lets users publish templates with fields for type, title, description, price, and login checks before submission.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Provides a support center page with contact options and a ticket submission form using local state and validation.
frontend/src/pages/TemplatesPage.tsx: Displays a grid of template cards with simple previews and navigation to the Create Studio when selected.
frontend/src/state/planStore.ts: Defines a persisted Zustand store for plan tier and billing period along with helper functions for feature access checks.
frontend/src/utils/designPreview.ts: Generates deterministic SVG design previews and applies user customizations based on occasion, style, and template options.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including support for hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, shadows, animations, and container settings using custom CSS variables.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing WishMint AI’s features, architecture notes, issues, and existing implemented requirements.
